delivery_config.Description: The settings for this subscription's message delivery.

delivery_requirement.Description: When this subscription should send messages to subscribers relative to messages persistence in storage. Possible values: ["DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY", "DELIVER_AFTER_STORED", "DELIVERY_REQUIREMENT_UNSPECIFIED"]

region.Description: The region of the pubsub lite topic.

topic.Description: A reference to a Topic resource.

zone.Description: The zone of the pubsub lite topic.
